mapper.select: /* TransactionMapper.selectMaxSeqNoCnt */ SELECT COUNT(EC_IF_SBMT_NO) + 1 FROM TB_EDI_GOV_ECOMMERCE WHERE REGISTER_DATE_TIME > CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 23);

/* TransactionMapper.selectTransOdInfo */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT
od.HBL_NO AS hbl_no , item.ORDER_NO AS ord_no , CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.AGENT_REG_NO, '') <> '' THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS elcm_pcd , od.URL AS ord_site_url , od.ORIG_COUNTRY AS elcm_ents_cnty_cd , od.AGENT_REG_NO AS puch_vcex_bsmn_sgn , od.AGENT_NAME AS puch_vcex_bsmn_nm , od.FORWARD_AGENT_CODE AS shpn_vcex_bsmn_sgn , od.FORWARD_AGENT_NAME AS shpn_vcex_bsmn_nm , od.ORDER_END_DATETIME AS ord_cmpl_dttm , od.ORDER_NAME AS ordrr_nm , od.ORDER_TEL AS ordrr_telno , od.ORDER_ACCOUNT AS ordrr_id , od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS cnsi_nm , od.CONSIGNEE_TEL AS cnsi_telno , od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE AS cnsi_psno , SUBSTRING(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC, 1, 50) AS cnsi_bscs_addr , SUBSTRING(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC, 51, 100) AS cnsi_dtl_addr , item.CUSTOMS_ID AS cnsi_pers_ecm , item.CUSTOMS_TEMP_NO AS su_crtf_no , '' AS smon_use_amt , '' AS smon_use_amt_curr_cd , item.DELIVERY_FEE AS spfe , 0 AS spfe_dscn_amt , item.CURRENCY_CODE AS spfe_curr_cd , item.ETC_AMOUNT AS cscl_agcs , item.ETC_CURRENCY_CODE AS cscl_agcs_curr_cd , '' AS tot_dscn_amt , '' AS tot_dscn_amt_curr_cd , item.AMOUNT_CUR AS tot_stlm_amt , item.CUR_CURRENCY_CODE AS tot_stlm_amt_curr_cd , item.PIECES AS tot_ord_prod_qty FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO , ORDER_NO , MAX(CUSTOMS_ID) AS CUSTOMS_ID , MAX(CUSTOMS_TEMP_NO) AS CUSTOMS_TEMP_NO , SUM(DELIVERY_FEE) AS DELIVERY_FEE , MAX(CURRENCY_CODE) AS CURRENCY_CODE , SUM(ETC_AMOUNT) AS ETC_AMOUNT , MAX(CURRENCY_CODE) AS ETC_CURRENCY_CODE , SUM(AMOUNT_CUR) AS AMOUNT_CUR , MAX(CURRENCY_CODE) AS CUR_CURRENCY_CODE , SUM(PIECES) AS PIECES FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} GROUP BY ORDER_NO ) item ON od.OD_JOB_NO = item.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* TransactionMapper.selectTransOdInfo */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT
od.HBL_NO AS hbl_no , item.ORDER_NO AS ord_no , CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.AGENT_REG_NO, '') <> '' THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS elcm_pcd , od.URL AS ord_site_url , od.ORIG_COUNTRY AS elcm_ents_cnty_cd , od.AGENT_REG_NO AS puch_vcex_bsmn_sgn , od.AGENT_NAME AS puch_vcex_bsmn_nm , od.FORWARD_AGENT_CODE AS shpn_vcex_bsmn_sgn , od.FORWARD_AGENT_NAME AS shpn_vcex_bsmn_nm , od.ORDER_END_DATETIME AS ord_cmpl_dttm , od.ORDER_NAME AS ordrr_nm , od.ORDER_TEL AS ordrr_telno , od.ORDER_ACCOUNT AS ordrr_id , od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS cnsi_nm , od.CONSIGNEE_TEL AS cnsi_telno , od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE AS cnsi_psno , SUBSTRING(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC, 1, 250) AS cnsi_bscs_addr , SUBSTRING(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC, 251, 300) AS cnsi_dtl_addr , item.CUSTOMS_ID AS cnsi_pers_ecm , item.CUSTOMS_TEMP_NO AS su_crtf_no , '' AS smon_use_amt , '' AS smon_use_amt_curr_cd , od.DELIVERY_FEE AS spfe , 0 AS spfe_dscn_amt , od.CURRENCY_CODE AS spfe_curr_cd , (SELECT SUM(AP_AMOUNT) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST WHERE CHARGE_CODE = 'DTY') AS cscl_agcs , od.CURRENCY_CODE AS cscl_agcs_curr_cd , '' AS tot_dscn_amt , '' AS tot_dscn_amt_curr_cd , od.AMOUNT_CUR AS tot_stlm_amt , od.CURRENCY_CODE AS tot_stlm_amt_curr_cd , od.PIECES_REAL AS tot_ord_prod_qty FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO, ORDER_NO, CUSTOMS_ID, CUSTOMS_TEMP_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) item ON od.OD_JOB_NO = item.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* TransactionMapper.selectTransProductInfoList */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT ITEM_NO AS prod_srno , CATEGORY_NAME_1 AS prod_clsf_nm_stp1 , CATEGORY_NAME_2 AS prod_clsf_nm_stp2 , CATEGORY_NAME_3 AS prod_clsf_nm_stp3 , CATEGORY_NAME_4 AS prod_clsf_nm_stp4 , CATEGORY_NAME_5 AS prod_clsf_nm_stp5 , CATEGORY_NAME_6 AS prod_clsf_nm_stp6 , CATEGORY_NAME_7 AS prod_clsf_nm_stp7 , CATEGORY_NAME_8 AS prod_clsf_nm_stp8 , CATEGORY_NAME_9 AS prod_clsf_nm_stp9 , DETAIL_ITEM_NAME AS ord_prod_nm , OPTION_NAME AS slct_opt_nm , ECM_URL AS prod_sale_pge_url , PIECES AS prod_ord_qty , UNIT_PRICE AS prod_unprc , CURRENCY_CODE AS prod_unprc_curr_cd , '' AS prod_dscn_amt , '' AS prod_dscn_amt_curr_cd , AMOUNT_CUR AS ord_amt , CURRENCY_CODE AS ord_amt_curr_cd , SELLER_NAME AS sale_ents_nm , SELLER_ID AS sale_ents_id , '' AS sale_ents_bsns_no , SELLER_CODE AS sale_ents_sgn , ITEM_ID AS prod_id , ITEM_MAF_NAME AS prod_mkr_nm , ITEM_MAF_MODEL_NO AS prod_mkr_mdl_no , ITEM_BRAND_NAME AS prod_brnd_nm FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* TransactionMapper.selectEdiPortalMailboxId */ SELECT TOP 1 EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_SMS_ENT_BUS_EDI_ECM edi ON od.ENT_CODE = edi.ENT_CODE AND od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = edi.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE AND od.BOUND = edi.BOUND AND od.EDI_CITY_PORT = edi.ORIG_CODE WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ORDER BY SEQ_NO

/* TransactionMapper.selectCustomerCode */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT CUST_VALUE FROM TB_ECM_OD CROSS APPLY ( VALUES (CUST_CODE_LV7), (CUST_CODE_LV6), (CUST_CODE_LV5), (CUST_CODE_LV4), (CUST_CODE_LV3), (CUST_CODE_LV2), (CUST_CODE_LV1) ) AS V(CUST_VALUE) WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND CUST_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CUST_VALUE)) <> ''
